what: Topology and Flows mounted on /lab and /es/lab with their generated SVGs inline.

ac6.note: Re-measured after deciding to keep the `tag` line. PR6 still removes IdpPage.astro.

findings: archify namespaces no ids; two inlined SVGs gave the document duplicate ids and both aria-labelledby targets resolved to the first diagram. Fixed by prefixing every id and reference at build time.
readFileSync(new URL(..., import.meta.url)) resolves to the bundled chunk and fails the build; Vite ?raw instead.
min-w-[754px] on a padded wrapper rendered the diagram at 730px, under the legibility floor, at 320 and 768 on both locales.
lab-containment required an external server and reported 8 connection refusals as 8 containment failures; it now serves dist/ itself.
lab-containment counted scrolling <figure> elements rather than the scroller, printing 0 at 320px where it must be 2. Now counted correctly and asserted.
The topology caption said 'Eight machines' while the Infra section two screens above says nine. The ninth is powered down and not drawn; the caption now says so.
